scripts.build: pnpm --filter @r4c/api prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @r4c/api build && pnpm --filter @r4c/web build && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('apps/web/.next/static','apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/.next/static',{recursive:true})"
scripts.local:setup: node -e "console.log(process.platform === 'win32' ? 'Run: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/local-setup.ps1' : 'Run: bash scripts/local-setup.sh')"
scripts.local:services: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio
